description: This file defines the 'Shape' class, which implements various interfaces related to display shapes, including methods for managing shape items, attributes, classes, and dynamic member access. It is part of the OrchardCore.DisplayManagement.Shapes namespace and appears to be central to shape rendering and manipulation within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: Represents a display shape with properties, child items, and dynamic member access, supporting shape composition, ordering, and rendering within OrchardCore.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds an item to the shape at a specified position, wrapping it if necessary.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a child shape by name.

methods.name: Named
methods.description: Retrieves a child shape by name.

methods.name: NormalizedNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a child shape by a normalized name, replacing '__' with '-'.

methods.name: TryGetMemberImpl
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a member, including named shapes.

methods.name: TrySetMemberImpl
methods.description: Sets properties or attributes on the shape, supporting dynamic member assignment.
